statement: The geometric monodromy on the ten common secant lines of two general twisted cubics in complex projective three-space is the full symmetric group S10.

answer.text: The family of ten common secant lines of two general twisted cubics in complex projective 3-space has full symmetric monodromy S10. The proof identifies two generating permutations by numerical exploration and proves their occurrence by certified homotopy path tracking; thus this is a certified group determination rather than an unverified numerical guess.

group.description: S10 on the ten common secant lines
